notes.teachingChoice: A bridge for a form not explicitly taught in the installed N4 course, rather than a claim that it is new N3 grammar. Potential-form prerequisites come from N4 unit 1. Distinguish achieved ability, new routine and a wish; negative loss is not drilled as mechanically interchangeable with ないようになる.

notes.form: ようにする / ようにしている

sources.url: https://jlptsensei.com/learn-japanese-grammar/ようにする-you-ni-suru-ようにしている-meaning/

notes.teachingChoice: Bridge ongoing conscious effort, with an explicit negative avoidance example. Contrast it with observed change; do not equate attempted habit with successful performance.
Mapping disagreement retained. Teach desired ability/state and avoided outcome, including different clause subjects. This is purpose, not noun resemblance のように from N4 unit 10.

notes.form: ために (purpose) versus ように
notes.teachingChoice: Dictionary-form deliberate goal and noun + のために. Treat shared subject/control as a useful tendency, not an exceptionless rule. Cause ために is deferred to N3 unit 9; it is not scored here.

remaining: Other N3–N1 outline rows still require form-specific review before their units are authored. This file does not certify the full advanced sequence.
